purpose: Provide a rigorous certificate format for the remaining phasecell-extremum derivative-root isolation problem.

function_class.basis: finite sums of c*x^alpha*(log x)^k with rational/explicit real coefficients, plus finite products for E2 derivatives
function_class.domain: compact phase cell intervals avoiding floor/divisibility/sign boundaries

certificate_objects.name: root_box
certificate_objects.data: [a,b] with F_prime(a)*F_prime(b)<=0 and interval evaluation of F_double_prime excludes 0, proving uniqueness

certificate_objects.name: boundary_box
certificate_objects.data: endpoint, floor boundary, sign boundary, or constraint boundary to be evaluated separately

certificate_objects.name: coverage
certificate_objects.data: ordered union of no_root_subintervals, root_boxes, and boundary boxes covers the whole cell

verification_rules: Use outward-rounded interval arithmetic for x^alpha and log x.
A no-root interval is certified if 0 notin interval(F_prime).
A root box is certified unique if F_prime changes sign or contains a Newton inclusion and interval(F_double_prime) excludes 0.
Every local extremum of F in the cell lies in a root_box or on a boundary_box.
Evaluate F with interval arithmetic on every candidate box; if the required inequality holds with margin, the cell is certified.
why_sufficient: This avoids needing a symbolic global root-count theorem; finite phase cells plus interval root isolation give a machine-checkable proof of all extrema.
remaining_implementation: Need scripts to emit and verify these certificates for R5global1--R5global4 candidate functionals.
